verdict.rationale: The changelog explicitly documents a Scheduled trigger that lets workflows run automatically on a recurring schedule, with a chosen interval and start time and no call event needed. Separately, the REST API supports scheduling calls within dialing windows and configuring retry behavior. The recurring-workflow capability, however, rests on a single changelog entry. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on schedule options (interval granularity, cron-style expressions, time zones, managing or pausing schedules), evidence that recurring schedules can be created or managed via the API or the MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
